… of 50,000

Active users are accounts that ran Archie in the last seven days, counted once each however many copies they run. A floor, not a headcount: an account whose copy nobody opens never reports.

Money
…

What the current plans bill in a normal month, what moved this month, and what Stripe is holding. A run rate, not an invoice: it ignores coupons, tax and part-months.

Health
…

Whether the billing service is up, whether its configuration arrived, and how today's free trial is going against the two ceilings that stop it.

Fleet
…

Which versions are alive, from each copy's daily heartbeat. An empty list means nobody has updated yet, not that nobody is running.

Attention
…

The three things worth knowing before anyone tells you: what has crashed, which remote levers are in force right now, and what shipped last.

Hudson
…

What the outbound agent has been doing, what it wants a decision on, and the week's running counts.
